expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "The smart/dumb/styles split you're describing is a pattern from a specific era... it actively works against an AI-assisted workflow"; "Don't do the smart/dumb/styles split."

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "Pull the data + side effects into a hook. useSavedCards()... and possibly useCheckoutSubmit()."

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one cohesive file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "180 lines of cohesive form code is fine"; revisit past ~300-400 lines.

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "Split it three ways and every non-trivial change becomes a multi-file hop: the agent edits the container, then has to thread a new prop... More files to locate... You pay a real token and accuracy tax."
